title: Audit: crypto2dev 2026-04-19
notes:
Confidence (updated after wolfCrypt source review):
FIPS gate coverage (provider callbacks): 100% — verified in wolfssl_*.c and kcapi_*.c.
Framework gate ordering: 5 violation clusters confirmed (P0) — gate called after fd state checks in write/read/finalize/reset/set_iv/gen_iv/set_aad/set_tag.
Key material leak risk: LOW — memzero_explicit consistent; two DO_KDF inbuf-persistence bugs are the main gap.
ECC peer key validation: CONFIRMED MISSING — wc_ecc_import_x963_ex passes untrusted=0, WOLFSSL_VALIDATE_ECC_IMPORT defaults off; zero SP 800-56A validation in default build (ecc.c lines 11039-11124, 10581-10734). Fix is one wc_ecc_check_key() call at wolfssl_ecdh.c:182.
GCM streaming: CONFIRMED REAL CIPHERTEXT — wc_AesGcmEncryptUpdate encrypts immediately (CTR-mode XOR, aes.c lines 12416-12475); wc_AesGcmEncryptFinal produces tag only. wolfssl and kcapi providers are incompatible at UAPI level.
Remaining gaps needing live system: lockdep run for sleeping-in-atomic confirmation; CMVP lab for framework gate ordering ruling.
